finding.claim: Untrusted YAML passed to Mail::Message.from_yaml can instantiate a permitted Mail::Sendmail object and install it as @delivery_method, leading to attacker-chosen command execution via IO.popen on deliver.
finding.source: Attacker-controlled YAML string passed to Mail::Message.from_yaml or Mail::Part.from_yaml (e.g. DB row, cache, upload)

trace.note: Mail::Sendmail and Mail::Exim are permitted classes
any key starting with '@' is accepted
IO.popen(command, 'w+') executes attacker-chosen binary and argv

finding.guards_checked: safe_load restricts classes but permits delivery-method classes; no filtering of @-prefixed keys; no validation of delivery method type; argv array form avoids shell but does not restrict executable. Precondition: application deserializes untrusted YAML. Static analysis only; not executed.

finding.claim: IMAP retrieval hardcodes certificate verification off (Net::IMAP.new verify=false), so credentials and mail are exposed to MITM on IMAPS connections.
finding.source: Network position: on-path attacker between app and IMAP server
finding.sink: Login credentials sent at imap.rb:175 and mail contents over an unverified TLS session

trace.note: Net::IMAP.new(address, port, enable_ssl, nil, false): fifth arg is verify=false

finding.guards_checked: imap.rb:166-168 only checks enable_starttls/enable_ssl mutual exclusion; no option to enable verification or set CA file (unlike SMTP smtp.rb:195-196).

finding.claim: POP3 retrieval hardcodes OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_NONE when enable_ssl is set, so credentials and mail are exposed to MITM.
finding.source: Network position: on-path attacker between app and POP3 server
finding.sink: POP3 login at pop3.rb:133 with user_name and password over unverified TLS
finding.guards_checked: None. VERIFY_NONE is a constant, not a configurable setting; no CA file option.

finding.claim: SMTP ssl_context mutates the shared Net::SMTP.default_ssl_context, so setting openssl_verify_mode on one delivery method disables or changes verification for every Net::SMTP connection in the process.
finding.source: App-level configuration openssl_verify_mode: 'none' on one delivery method
finding.sink: Global Net::SMTP.default_ssl_context verify_mode used by all Net::SMTP TLS sessions

trace.note: context.verify_mode = openssl_verify_mode mutates the shared object

finding.guards_checked: None. Context is shared and mutated instead of copied per connection.
